name: picker
description: THE PICKER'S THEME (2026-10-04; the chrome round, then the flags round): themes/warptempo.json with the chrome as ONE KNOB, its ground #191919 under the chrome rule (`chrome`: Windows 95's proportions, every relief line, the field and the emboss's light copy following the ground; at #191919 the theme warptempo's own row), the canvas #0E0E0E, the ink #A6B9DE (the ink round's latest pick), the outline by its rule ("auto": the 50 % linear-light blend of the ink over the canvas), the flag's face #666699 and its selected face #9999CC (the current design for now, CE01), BOTH LABELS WHITE (architect 2026-10-04: consistency; `flag_label_sel` #FFFFFF where the app's default is #000000), the selected fill #666666 (fixed until the open-flag round). Exported with --export for tools/palette/picker/: five elements in the architect's order of importance (2026-10-04), Chrome (active), Canvas and Ink over the scene `waveform` (the ink round's: the marker stems, the flags, the playhead and row 8's state line switched off), then Unselected Flag and Selected Flag over the scene `flags` (the waveform scene with the stems and the flags on, the fourth flag from the left SELECTED with its payload box the addressed cell, so its stem is bright: the state he meets a selected flag in most). The invalid faces, their labels and the flag outline stay fixed roles. The next round, a new element and scene here and a new export: the open flag with its selection (where the selected fill becomes pickable).
